title: ChatPlugin
description: Manage your Minecraft chat with ease
body:
# Chat Management
This plugin is an easy way to setup prefixes and managing the chat itself.
# Features
- Use global prefixes or use player prefixes that only that one player has (recommended)
- Set default prefix such as &7Member
- Toggle chat on and off
# Dependencies
For the plugin to work you need the permissions plugin LuckPerms otherwise the plugin **WON'T** work.
# Commands
- /chatplugin reload - Reload the plugin
- ~~/chatplugin license - If you got a license, put it here~~ (This was removed in BETA 2.0.0)
- /chatplugin prefix - Main command for the prefixes
- /chatplugin prefix add|remove|list|clear|default|player - All the prefix commands
# Languages
The plugin is normally on Dutch but you can change it if you want (/plugins/ChatPlugin/lang.yml or /plugins/ChatPlugin/lang_en_us.yml).
